criteria.name: Expressed
criteria.met_when: GTEx median TPM at least 1 in the run's region (fallback: tissue-distribution score above 0 if GTEx is absent)
criteria.hover: Expressed: the gene's median expression in the run's region in GTEx, a public atlas of gene activity by tissue, is at least 1 TPM (transcripts per million). Where GTEx has no median for a gene, Open Targets' tissue-distribution score decides instead; that score runs from -1 to +1 and this rule counts any score above 0.
criteria.source: GTEx median TPM, Open Targets prioritisation

criteria.name: Dysregulated in this study
criteria.hover: Dysregulated: log2 fold change: each +1 is a doubling, so +2.6 is about 6 times higher, and adjusted p is the significance after correcting for testing every gene. This rule counts |log2 fold change| of at least 1 with adjusted p at 0.05 or below, both read from the table you submitted.

criteria.name: Phenotype in a study
criteria.met_when: mouse-KO ring above 0 on its 0-to-1 scale, or ≥ 1 abnormal mouse phenotype term(s)
criteria.hover: Phenotype in a study: Open Targets records which mouse genes have been knocked out and what changed. The ring is three states, not a number: an abnormal phenotype on record, none on record, or no record at all (drawn hatched). This rule counts a ring above 0, or at least 1 abnormal mouse term. A mouse result is a lead, never a verdict.

verdict_rule.insufficient: none not met, but any no data
verdict_rule.never_a_criterion: Safety and toxicity rings, druggability rings, clinical stage, drug count and literature volume. A target is not excluded for missing toxicity data or for low druggability, because a chemist can resolve both. These print as a caveat line under the verdict, never as an exclusion.

accounts.purpose: large language model triage of the top 10 genes (not built; nothing has ever been spent on it)
the phenotype-page summary, one call per gene, summarising only the table printed below it
the contrast chooser, one call per disease, choosing only among contrasts the index already offered it
the region chooser, one call per disease and then cached, choosing only among the GTEx tissues this build can read
the per-gene evidence summary, baked offline before publication from the gene's own drawer values and served as a file; the app never makes this call

spend.note: No paid call is on the render path: the figure draws without an API key. Each account has its own cap and none borrows from another. Model prices change, so these are the amounts this project had spent by the date above, not a price list.

no_ranking: There is no score, no weighted sum and no ranking of any kind. The spoke order is a decision. It is stated on the figure and it is checked in the artefact. The rings are evidence for a reader to weigh.
